source.name: Open English WordNet
source.why_preferred: Open English WordNet is the canonical open English wordnet already supported by the repository's wordnet-json importer shape; use the core 2025 JSON release before considering Plus or Namenet variants.

full_commit_sha.description: Record the immutable full Git commit SHA for the 2025-edition tag before import.

sha256.description: Compute SHA-256 from the reviewed local artifact outside the repository.

bytes.description: Record byte count from the reviewed local artifact outside the repository.

retrieved_at.description: Record the UTC retrieval date/time used for the reviewed artifact.

archive_member_manifest.description: Record zip member names, per-member hashes, and the exact JSON member selected for import.

open_questions: Confirm whether the JSON zip contains LICENSE.md and WNDB_License.txt or whether notices must be copied from the matching tagged repository tree.
Confirm the exact attribution text required in pack.php and public docs for both Princeton WordNet and the Open English WordNet Team.
Confirm WordPress.org package redistribution compatibility for the source-chain notices before committing generated runtime files.

importer.command_template: php language-fts-playground/tools/import-lexical-source.php wordnet-json "$OEWN_EXTRACTED_JSON" "$LANGUAGE_FTS_OEWN_OUTPUT_DIR" --language=en --data-kind=imported_comprehensive --source-name="Open English WordNet" --source-url="https://github.com/globalwordnet/english-wordnet" --source-version="2025 Edition" --source-retrieved-at="$OEWN_RETRIEVED_AT" --source-artifact-name=english-wordnet-2025-json.zip --source-artifact-url=https://en-word.net/static/english-wordnet-2025-json.zip --source-artifact-sha256="$OEWN_SHA256" --source-artifact-bytes="$OEWN_BYTES" --license-name="Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International plus Princeton WordNet source notice" --license-id=CC-BY-4.0 --license-url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ --license-text-url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt --license-text-file=LICENSE.oewn.txt --normalization-profile-version=language-fts-playground-normalization-v1 --attribution="$OEWN_ATTRIBUTION" --pack-version="$OEWN_PACK_VERSION" --pack-date="$OEWN_PACK_DATE" --provenance=oewn-2025-core-reviewed --command-artifact-label=oewn-2025-json-source-artifact
pre_extraction_questions: Verify the selected JSON member has the Global Wordnet JSON-LD shape already handled by the importer or document a deterministic pre-extraction step.
Decide whether the current JSON importer can handle the full artifact in memory or whether a streaming/pre-extracted membership pass is required.
Verify that core 2025 rows are imported and Plus/Namenet proper-noun extensions are excluded from this first comprehensive English pack.
Run the import twice from the same reviewed artifact and compare generated runtime outputs and pack.lock.json byte for byte.

determinism: Generated profile resources are byte-for-byte stable across two imports.
pack.lock.json records all runtime files, source artifact fields, license notices, importer command, and normalization profile evidence.

real_import_no_go_conditions: Do not download, vendor, or commit english-wordnet-2025-json.zip in this repository.
Do not generate or commit OEWN runtime lexical packs until exact artifact hashes, byte counts, notices, and deterministic import output are reviewed.
Do not include Open English WordNet Plus or Open English Namenet in the first core OEWN candidate import.
Do not claim comprehensive English lexical support until validator, evaluator, fanout, benchmark, license, and package-size gates pass.
